line: [Intro: Scarface] “Mo—money and the power, money and the power”
vault_lines: "Mo—money and the power, money and the power"
meaning:
There are three samples on “CALLDROPS.” Chronologically, the first sample is of DJ Squeeky’s “Money & the Power,” which contains a sample of Southern rap legend Scarface’s “Money and the Power.” Rocky pulls much of his musical style from the iconic ‘Chopped & Screwed’ sound of the Dirty South, and we can see this sample as another homage to the roots of Rocky’s artistry. This also explains why he sampled DJ Squeeky’s take on the Scarface sample, versus directly sample Scarface’s vocals.

1st sample origin (DJ Squeeky)

The second sample, one of mellow guitar, is of Dave Bixby’s “Morning Sun.” This sample acts as the driving sound in production on “CALLDROPS.”

2nd sample origin

2nd sample usage

Sample three is only heard in the intro, but is very recognizably from Jeru The Damaja’s “Come Clean.”
